hypothesis.statement: A single unpinned AI reconstruction can bias identity decisions and be mistaken for production topology.
hypothesis.action: Require equal TRELLIS.2 and Hunyuan3D runs over three fixed seeds, identical canonical inputs, cleanup, measurements and fixed Looking Glass Go renders before human selection.
hypothesis.expectedResult: Six independently attributable temporary shape estimates can be compared without allowing any AI mesh to become the production character.

actualResult.blocker: Neither pinned local model runner nor reviewed weights are available in the current workspace.

qualityGate: both reconstruction models use the same canonical source manifest and seed set
runner, repository, revision, weights checksum and license review are mandatory
every candidate emits raw mesh, normalized Blender file, cleanup report, nine fixed-view renders, face/body measurements and evaluation
selection is forbidden before all six candidates validate
selection requires measurements and human review and remains shape-reference-only
all presentation renders use the Looking Glass Go 1440x2560 portrait profile
decision: Keep the fail-closed benchmark contract; do not fabricate candidates or select a reconstruction until both toolchains are installed and pinned.
